metas.name: 1 · ★ 5.5 · 2008 · Risto Räppääjä
metas.description: Ricky Rapper is a ten year old boy who lives with his aunt Serena and likes to play drums and rap. His aunt breaks her leg, leading to cousin Fanny moving in to take care of the household.  Fanny is very strict and that means no more drums for Ricky. With the help of his downstair neighbor Nelly, Ricky seeks to restore the normal order to the apartment.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.3 · 2010 · Ricky Rapper and the Bicycle Thief
metas.description: Summer vacation has just begun. In honor of it, Serena Rapper and Lennart Lindberg decide to go on holiday. Ricky gets a new bicycle as a consolation, but it disappears mysteriously. Ricky and Nelly Noodlehead go looking for it which turns into a thrilling adventure.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.3 · 2012 · Ricky Rapper and Cool Wendy
metas.description: Ricky and Nelly travel to an island where aunt Elvi has a job at a resort.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.2 · 2014 · Risto Räppääjä ja liukas Lennart
metas.description: Aunt Elvi and aunt Rauha try to find a suitable father figure for Ricky.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 5.0 · 2015 · Ricky Rapper and the Miser from Seville
metas.description: Ricky Rapper gets a letter from a distant relative who's looking for an heir.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 4.4 · 2016 · Ricky Rapper and the Nighthawk
metas.description: Ricky finds a ring, which leads to the start of an archaeological dig.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 5.1 · 2019 · Risto Räppääjä ja pullistelija
metas.description: It's summer and Risto takes his friend Nella, Aunt Rita and neighbor Lennart to a holiday village. There they meet Bill and Sylvester Pöntinen, father and son who are preparing for a competition and flexing their muscles to be the...

metas.name: 8 · ★ 5.0 · 2020 · Risto Räppääjä ja väärä Vincent
metas.description: A young boy is believed to be the reincarnation of Vincent van Gogh.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 4.5 · 2023 · Risto Räppääjä ja villi kone
metas.description: Ricky Rapper is bored because his best friend Nelly Noodlehead is only interested in young pop singer Ville Pyry. Everything changes when downstairs neighbour Lennart Lindberg lends Ricky his old video game.
